description: This file defines the backend code for an admin queue management webpage in an online exam system. It handles page load events, session validation, database queries to check course queue status, and navigation through server transfers based on user interactions.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminQueue page, handling its lifecycle, session validation, database operations related to course queue status, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load, checks session variables, and manages course queue existence validation in the database.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the admin panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the admin queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the current user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection changes in GridView, storing selected row data into session variables and navigating to the answer view page.
